title: Native Network Log
stored_only: Stored CH7465 events only. Refresh reads the database; it does not query the modem. Newest stored events appear first.
raw_time: Modem-reported time is shown exactly as stored. Its timezone is unverified; no timezone conversion is applied.
native_log_disabled: CH7465 native-log collection is disabled. Previously stored events remain available.
auth_required: Configure an administrator password and sign in to view native events.
empty: No stored native events for the configured modem.
no_older: No older stored events. Refresh to return to the newest events.
error: Could not load stored native events. Try Refresh again.
session_required: Authentication is required. Sign in again to view native events.
